observations: Orange gas cylinder with two top handles.
Brand 'REPSOL' and 'TOKUNBO' visible on the label.
The cylinder is wrapped in a hexagonal wire mesh.
A handwritten 'A3' is visible on the top of the cylinder in both photos.
The cylinder shows significant surface wear and rust, particularly on the top and sides.
A watermark 'DANIEL DIBO POSTED ON JIJI' is present on both images.

claims.evidence: The brand name 'TOKUNBO' is clearly printed on the label in both photos.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud or handle.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be leaking or have a damaged valve.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve or a close-up of the valve threads.
risks.if_unproven: as having a leak or faulty valve

risks.risk: The cylinder may be a counterfeit or replica.
risks.proof: A photo of the 3rd-party inspection mark (usually a metal plate) on the shroud.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic or replica cylinder

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the shroud or handle.
Photo of the 3rd-party inspection mark on the shroud.
Video of a soap bubble test on the valve.
Close-up photo of the valve threads.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
